## Session changes — 2026-08-30 (parent 1d4b96f5901d)

**Added a full xlink_project fixture suite and comprehensive cross-language edge-detection tests covering URL normalisation, match confidence, fetch-site extraction, and route-definition extraction.**

Six new fixture triefacts and one large test module were added to support cross-language link (`xlink`) detection testing.

Fixture files added:

- `backend/api/admin.py` — Flask `app` and `bp` constants plus route handlers `get_stats`, `get_settings`, `update_settings`, `bulk_update`, and `get_item`.
- `backend/api/users.py` — FastAPI `app` constant and handlers `list_users`, `get_user`, `create_user`, and `delete_user`.
- `frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx` — async client functions `getAdminStats`, `updateSettings`, `getItemDetails`, and `bulkUpdate` that call the admin API via axios.
- `frontend/src/components/UserList.tsx` — async client functions `fetchUsers`, `fetchUserById`, `createUser`, and `deleteUser` calling the users API.
- `server/gateway.ts` — Express `app`, `setupGateway`, and `checkHealth`.
- `server/routes.ts` — Express `app`, `router`, and `setupRoutes`.

`tests/test_xlink.py` adds helpers `_parse_ts`, `_parse_py`, and `_dummy_symbols`, plus test classes `TestNormalizeUrl`, `TestMatchConfidence`, `TestExtractFetchSites`, and additional classes covering route extraction and end-to-end xlink resolution against the new fixtures.
